offer.text: A young miner's heading out green. Craft an iron pickaxe so he doesn't dig with his fingers.

accept.text: Good iron, good haft. He'll thank you for it.

decline.text: He'll learn the hard way, then.

ready.text: A proper pickaxe! He'll mine for years with this.

complete.text: You've set a lad on a good path today.
